summary.text: Jesse Pippy is a Republican member of the Maryland House of Delegates from District 4 who was first elected in 2018 and has served since January 9, 2019, and he is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
An attorney, he is the House Minority Whip and serves on the Economic Matters Committee.

paragraphs.text: Jesse Pippy was born on August 6, 1982, and earned a B.A. in political science from Christopher Newport University in 2004, according to his General Assembly biography.
He attended the University of Maryland Francis King Carey School of Law and works as an attorney.
Pippy chaired the Frederick County Young Republicans from 2015 to 2017 and the Board of License Commissioners for Frederick County from 2016 to 2018.
Pippy served on the Judiciary Committee from 2019 to 2021 and has been a member of the Economic Matters Committee since 2021.
He has been House Minority Whip since 2023 and also sits on the Rules and Executive Nominations Committee, the Legislative Policy Committee and the Spending Affordability Committee.

His biography lists the Maryland State's Attorneys' Association's Legislator of the Year award for 2021 and the American Conservative Union Foundation's Conservative Achievement Award for 2019 and 2020.
Ballotpedia reports that he advanced from the June 23, 2026 Republican primary.
